"""Generate and verify a replayable trajectory for the frozen cube/bowl instance."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session

INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
OUT = Path("/app/output/trajectory.npz")

s = Session("rubiks_cube_in_front_of_bowl", instance=INSTANCE)
p = s.primitives()
print("initial status", s.status(), flush=True)
print("objects", s.objects(), flush=True)
print("initial ee", s.ee_pose(), "closing", p["get_finger_closing_dir"](), flush=True)

# Grasp the cube at the center of its measured visual bounds.  The cube's
# rigid-body origin is offset from that visual center, so the final target is
# specified in rigid-body coordinates below.
cube_bounds = np.asarray(s.objects()["rubiks_cube"]["bounds"], dtype=float)
cube_visual_center = cube_bounds.mean(axis=0)
top = float(s.objects()["table"]["bounds"][1][2])
cube_half_z = float((cube_bounds[1, 2] - cube_bounds[0, 2]) / 2)
grasp_z = top + cube_half_z + 0.001
yaw = 0.0
q = p["top_down_quat"](yaw)

s.record_start()
# Approach from above, descend to the cube's mid-height, close, and lift clear.
p["open_gripper"](steps=3)
p["move_ee"]([cube_visual_center[0], cube_visual_center[1], grasp_z + 0.13], q, speed=0.18, settle=2)
p["move_ee"]([cube_visual_center[0], cube_visual_center[1], grasp_z], q, speed=0.10, settle=2)
p["close_gripper"](steps=20)
p["move_ee"]([cube_visual_center[0], cube_visual_center[1], grasp_z + 0.16], q, speed=0.15, settle=4)

# In this task, "in front" is the negative robot-local x cone.  Put the cube
# center at x=0.30, directly aligned with the bowl's rigid-body y coordinate.
bowl_pos = np.asarray(s.objects()["bowl"]["position"], dtype=float)
cube_root = np.asarray(s.objects()["rubiks_cube"]["position"], dtype=float)
visual_offset = cube_visual_center - cube_root
place_root_xy = np.array([0.30, bowl_pos[1]])
place_visual_xy = place_root_xy + visual_offset[:2]
p["move_ee"]([place_visual_xy[0], place_visual_xy[1], grasp_z + 0.17], q, speed=0.18, settle=4)
p["move_ee"]([place_visual_xy[0], place_visual_xy[1], grasp_z], q, speed=0.10, settle=4)
p["open_gripper"](steps=25)
if not s.episode_done:
    p["move_ee"]([place_visual_xy[0], place_visual_xy[1], grasp_z + 0.13], q, speed=0.12, settle=5)

# Any successful terminal event stops further commands; record_stop is safe
# whether the episode ended during release or after retreat.
actions = s.record_stop()
s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={"target_rigid_body_xy": place_root_xy.tolist(), "cube_visual_center_start": cube_visual_center.tolist()})
print("recorded", actions.shape, "live status", s.status(), flush=True)

# The first replay in this process is bit-for-bit equivalent to a fresh run.
replay_status = s.replay(actions)
print("self-replay", replay_status, flush=True)
if not replay_status["success"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Recorded trajectory did not succeed on replay")
